design_role: post-outcome continuation of PR168 double geographic and genus holdout; not prospective evidence

analogy_definition.primary_distance: training-only standardized Euclidean, equal squared-distance weight per abiotic block
analogy_definition.neighbors: nearest5 distinct training genera, excluding query genus
analogy_definition.calibration: at most1024 outcome-blind source-ID-hash-selected training species, one site unit per species

primary_analogue_sensitivity.outcome: No positive95pct joint-gain interval in analogous groups across both weighting schemes, both distances, four completeness/quality cohorts, both exclusion regimes and fixed50/90/95 screens. This is not evidence for absence of biological environmental effects.

uncertainty.primary_intervals: two-sided95%, also97.5% for two primary regimes
uncertainty.conditioning: fixed previous predictions, fixed analogy flags and full-pool weights; thresholds/model fits not re-estimated in bootstrap

scientific_ceiling: Empirical data overlap, not natural habitat rarity or guaranteed model applicability.
Analogue and outside groups can share species; photo/unit counts partition but species counts do not add.
Differences among subgroups are not causal mediation or proof of region-specific pigment tradeoffs.
Geography/lineage, floral organ, exposure, observer and MNAR effects remain.
Long-term environmental rasters do not measure actual plant stress, pigment cost, pollination, herbivory or fitness.
Wide analogue intervals neither verify a universal response nor establish differing biological mechanisms.
full_reproduction_package: Conversation file FCP_all36_environment_analogues_20261011.zip contains complete final_result.json, all source-unit analogy ledgers, calibration tables, exact scripts, dependencies,11 tests, verification script and necessary prior loss ledgers; no raw photo pixels.
